versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the vision-understanding skill.
- Converts images, videos, audio, or documents into text for tasks like captioning, tagging, transcription, summary, OCR, and visual Q&A.
- Supports multiple input types and integrates with various models, including Qwen2.5-VL, Gemini 3.1 Pro, LLaVA, and Memories.
- Outlines clear workflow steps for media-to-text processing and emphasizes model selection based on input modality.
- Provides guidance for structured extraction, output shape specification, and parameter handling.
- Ensures outputs are grounded in the actual media and validated for completeness and correctness.
